title: The Hymn of Cold Spring
author: Hazel Thackeray
blurb: Elodie Voss, a pest controller called to something with fingerprints, doesn't believe, has never believed, will not begin believing now. Then the sleep recordings capture a second voice answering questions — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must learn the song's last verse without singing along before the frost writes its final pattern.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
